note: Literature links PLAA mutations to lethal infantile epileptic encephalopathy presenting as PEHO or PEHO-like syndrome, with optic atrophy and seizures reported in variable subsets of cases.

evidence.text: Hypomorphic mutations in PLAA cause an infantile neurodysfunction syndrome where patients presented with phenotypes diagnosed as PEHO syndrome, optic atrophy developed in the first year, and most but not necessarily all patients experienced seizures.
